key_highlights: ASX falls as Middle East oil spike fuels inflation and RBA rate-hike fears; bond yields spike in a 'once-in-a-generation' sell-off
Australia's inflation confirmed as domestically driven, complicating RBA policy path
CSL signs US pricing deal with Trump administration, capping revenue upside on key medicines
Coal sector booms; gold and critical minerals discoveries (King River 44g/t, McLaren titanium, Larvotto antimony) support materials sector
Sydney house price crash gains global attention; property developer Bathla nears collapse; investor credit growth crashes post-budget
Qantas ground crews vote for strike right amid pay dispute; Star Entertainment blames prior management for losses
Top central banker warns AI disruption poses 'contagion risk' to global economy
Mineral Resources/Chris Ellison ASIC probe closed with no action; Capricorn Energy backs DNO's $396M bid

sectors.trend: Coal boom lifts energy miners; gold (King River 44g/t, Moonlight Qld) and critical minerals (McLaren titanium, Larvotto antimony, Viking tungsten) see strong exploration results. Oil spike supports upstream energy names.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from commodity strength but face inflation-driven demand risk. Gold juniors (KRG.AX, MLD.AX) and critical-minerals names (LAR.AX) attract speculative flows. Coal names (WDS.AX, LSE.AX) see near-term tailwind.

sectors.trend: Once-in-a-generation bond sell-off pressures bank funding costs and NIMs. Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes, raising NPL concerns. High-yield savings rates at 4.15% APY signal tight monetary stance.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression from rising bond yields. Housing stress (Sydney crash, Bathla collapse) elevates credit-risk premiums. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by higher discount rates.

sectors.trend: CSL's US pricing deal with Trump administration caps medicine revenue. August data shows strong weight-loss drug demand. NT health IT inquiry highlights system fragility.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces structural margin pressure from US price cuts; offset by volume and non-US markets. Weight-loss drug theme supports CSL and smaller biotech names. Defensive sector but policy headwinds persist.

sectors.trend: Oil spike on Middle East tensions lifts upstream. Danish wind-farm entrant addresses Australia's renewable pipeline gap. Diesel shock described as permanent structural cost.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, AWE.AX, LNC.AX benefit from oil strength. Renewable developers (SOL.AX, LEM.AX) gain from policy support. Diesel cost inflation pressures transport and logistics (QAN.AX, WES.AX).

sectors.trend: Per-capita recession fears; 'dupe' brand preference and EV uptake accelerate. 161-year-old kids clothing giant closes 29 stores. Qantas strike risk disrupts travel.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, IAG.AX face soft consumer spending. QAN.AX exposed to industrial action. EV adoption supports battery and charging-infrastructure names.

sectors.trend: AI 'contagion risk' warning from top central banker. Star Entertainment blames prior management. Meta $24B settlement linked to AU social media ban. Canva privacy legal fight.
sectors.implications: STAR.AX recovery uncertain. AI disruption could hit ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) valuations. Meta settlement may pressure social-media ad spend. Canva (private) privacy risk noted.

key_themes: Oil-driven inflation and RBA rate-hike risk dominate near-term ASX direction
Australian bond market stress (once-in-a-generation sell-off) transmits to equities via discount rates
Domestic inflation confirmed as home-grown, limiting RBA easing options
Housing market deterioration (Sydney crash, developer collapses, credit crunch) is a systemic risk
Commodity strength (coal, gold, critical minerals) provides sector-specific support
CSL US pricing deal signals structural margin pressure on Australian healthcare exports
AI disruption flagged as macro 'contagion risk' by senior central banker
Industrial action risk (Qantas) and corporate governance issues (Star, Bathla) add idiosyncratic risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced rate hike / bond market instability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge duration risk; favour short-duration and floating-rate instruments; monitor 10-yr GBA yield

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market contagion (Sydney crash, developer defaults)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property-exposed equity weight; monitor NAB/CBA housing loan NPL data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / Middle East escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight upstream energy (WDS.AX, AWE.AX); hedge transport/logistics exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: CSL US pricing deal / healthcare margin compression
risk_assessment.mitigation: Re-rate CSL.AX expectations; diversify into non-US healthcare exposure
Monitor labour-market data; favour AI-beneficiary equities over displaced sectors
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; assess travel-sector spillover to WES.AX, IAG.AX

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream energy and coal producers
opportunities.rationale: Oil spike on Middle East tensions plus domestic coal boom provide near-term revenue tailwind
Strong exploration results (King River 44g/t, McLaren titanium, Larvotto antimony) plus safe-haven demand from bond sell-off

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare with non-US revenue mix
opportunities.rationale: CSL US pricing deal caps upside but weight-loss drug demand and global pipeline provide floor

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property-exposed equity weight
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney crash, Bathla near-collapse, and investor credit crunch signal elevated default risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration or floating-rate instruments
defensive_moves.rationale: Once-in-a-generation bond sell-off and RBA hike fears elevate discount rates across equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas and travel-exposed names near-term
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground-crew strike vote creates operational and earnings uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely under pressure over 1–3 months as oil-driven inflation forces RBA to hold or hike, bond yields remain elevated, and housing stress feeds through to bank credit metrics. Materials and energy outperform; financials, REITs, and consumer lag. Volatility elevated on Middle East headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA pivots. Coal and critical-minerals structural demand supports materials. CSL US pricing deal is a one-time re-rating event. Housing correction may stabilise by H2 2027. AI disruption remains a tail risk to productivity and employment.

10-yr GBA yield direction post bond sell-off
Middle East oil supply resolution or escalation
Qantas strike outcome and industrial relations
CSL US deal implementation and margin impact
Housing credit data and developer default cascade
watch_list: Iron ore, coal, gold, LNG spot prices
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
CBA.AX / NAB.AX housing NPL and credit-growth data
CSL.AX US revenue mix and margin commentary
